[`_boxes_near_sweep`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/movement/spatial.py#L228-L238) retains its existing 4-tuple return contract.

Only boxes that actively clamped the displacement vector and formed the final contact surface are recorded.
   - **Legacy Compatibility**: [`slide(start, desired, contract)`](file:///C:/Users/Rita/Desktop/caleb/world_simulator/at_the_beginning/systems/movement/spatial.py#L240) preserves its public legacy return signature `(nx, ny)` and bit-identical physics when called without diagnostics.

---

### Telemetry Invariants & Counting Rules

- **What Counts**: Attempted movement restricted or slid along a void box boundary. Bounded to at most 1 void hit per actor movement attempt per tick, even if both sweep phases (e.g. corner collisions) touch void boxes.
- **What Never Counts**:
  - Authored or chunk walls (tallied under `wall_hits`, never `void_hits`).
  - Proximity without contact (approaching near a barrier).
  - Out-of-bounds endpoints clamped by world bounds (`bounds`).
  - Distance shortfall from step sizing or stamina limits.
  - Stale resident inputs or teleport relocation where `desired == start`.
  - Embedded actors held at spawn.
